newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl consolidates retail units.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl consolidates retail units.

text.p: Edison International announced Tuesday the formation of Edison Enterprises, which consolidates the company's three retail businesses -- Edison Source, Edison Select and Edison EV (Electric Vehicles).

Edison said the retail companies -- all created in 1996 -- will retain their individual brand identity and autonomy as unregulated units of Edison International, but they also will share services through a new corporate center.

"This consolidation should maximize efficiency and help us better coordinate our efforts in reaching customers with innovative products and services not traditionally associated with electric utilities," said Edison Enterprises' chief executive officer Stephen Pazian, who joined the company in May to organize and oversee the effort.
Edison also announced Tuesday the appointment of telecommunications executive Robert Handell as president of Edison Source, effective July 14.
Edison Source provides energy services and pricing options to businesses throughout the US.
Edison Select provides products and services for the consumer market, while Edison EV distributes, installs and services electric vehicle charging equipment.
Edison's other subsidiaries are Southern California Edison Co, Edison Mission Energy and Edison Capital.
